annotation.authors_or_issuer: Wada, K.; Shibata, T.; Kawaguchi, Y.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five-year experiment with Paro seal robots at a Japanese elderly health service facility
Interaction improved elderly people's moods, measured by face scales and caregiver observation
Relationships between elderly residents and robots persisted over five years
Caregivers widely accepted Paro and reported more activity and communication
Study conducted with informed consent under AIST ethics committee
annotation.summary_en: 2009 IEEE ICORR conference paper reporting a five-year case study of Paro therapeutic seal robots in a Japanese elderly care facility. Interaction improved residents' moods and sustained relationships. It is an empirical study with no governance content; the cover-page title (robot butlers) does not match the PDF.
annotation.title_clean: Long-term Robot Therapy in a Health Service Facility for the Aged – A Case Study for 5 Years
annotation.title_en: Long-term Robot Therapy in a Health Service Facility for the Aged – A Case Study for 5 Years
annotation.venue: 2009 IEEE 11th International Conference on Rehabilitation Robotics
